description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It handles the app's main user interface, including fragment management, menu options for showing and hiding logs, and initialization of logging systems with support for on-screen logging display.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity extends SampleActivityBase, managing the main UI for NFC provisioning, including fragment setup, menu interactions, and logging initialization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the NfcProvisioningFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from the menu resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, toggling the visibility and title of the log toggle item based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling the log display with animation.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain, wrapping Android logs and supporting on-screen log display.
